Software

I maintain and contribute to several R packages, all available on GitHub.

scAmbi

Mapping ambiguity overdispersion correction and BCV analysis for scRNA-seq.
metacleaner

Automated curation of barcode sequence databases for metabarcoding and metagenomics.
iconic

Causal model selection with genetic instruments and negative controls.
SQANTI3

Quality control and filtering of long read-defined transcriptomes.
